say:3:1120305001:0.text: I'm sorry, Alsa... *Cough* But I'm still...*Cough*
say:3:1120305001:0.source_cn: 对不起，阿尔萨，咳咳，姐姐……我还是……咳咳！

say:4:1120305002:0.source_cn: 明明已经吃了药，为什么病情还是没有好转……

say:5:1120305003:1.text: Maybe it just needs more time to take effect?
say:5:1120305003:1.source_cn: 呃，难道是还没到起效的时间？

say:8:1120305004:1.text: Don't be silly, Chippy! It should've started working by now!
say:8:1120305004:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，药都喝了这么久了，早就该起作用了！

say:9:1120305005:0.text: What should I do? Aside from this herb... I don't know how else to treat him...
say:9:1120305005:0.source_cn: 怎么办……除了这种草药，我不知道其他治疗的办法了……

say:10:1120305006:0.text: It's all my fault! If only I had noticed the problem sooner... I'm so sorry, Karun...
say:10:1120305006:0.source_cn: 都怪我，如果我早点发现问题就好了……都是我的错……

choice_prompt:11:1120305006.text: It's all my fault! If only I had noticed the problem sooner... I'm so sorry, Karun...
choice_prompt:11:1120305006.source_cn: 都怪我，如果我早点发现问题就好了……都是我的错……

say:12:1120305007:1.text: You're right, panicking won't solve anything... My stress got the better of me just now. Sorry.
say:12:1120305007:1.source_cn: 你说得对，我现在着急也没有用……抱歉，是我急昏头了。

say:13:1120305008:1.text: I know how you feel! We were just as anxious when you were stabbed with that poisoned dagger and passed out!
say:13:1120305008:1.source_cn: 没关系！之前阿尔萨被毒匕首刺伤晕倒的时候，大家也是这么...

say:14:1120305009:1.text: Poisoned dagger... and me passing out...

say:15:1120305010:1.text: Come to think of it, who healed me back at the Warsong Festival?
say:15:1120305010:1.source_cn: 说起来，之前我在战歌节上受伤的那次，是谁把我治好的？

say:18:1120305011:1.text: Smokey did! That meerkat really knows how to mix his herbs!
say:18:1120305011:1.source_cn: 那只叫阿熏的狐獴。他好像很擅长制药。

say:19:1120305012:1.text: If he's really that talented, I wonder if he can heal Karun as well...?
say:19:1120305012:1.source_cn: 如果他真的这么厉害的话，不知道能不能帮帮这孩子……

choice_prompt:20:1120305012.text: If he's really that talented, I wonder if he can heal Karun as well...?
choice_prompt:20:1120305012.source_cn: 如果他真的这么厉害的话，不知道能不能帮帮这孩子……

say:22:1120305015:1.text: Then... Do you know where we can find Smokey?
say:22:1120305015:1.source_cn: 唔……可是，我们现在要去哪里找到这位阿熏呢？

say:23:1120305016:1.text: If I remember correctly, Mikola was the one who brought him to the Warsong Festival. We should ask her first.
say:23:1120305016:1.source_cn: 我记得之前在战歌节上，是曼卡拉把他带过来的。我们可以找...

say:24:1120305017:1.text: Then let's go. We can't waste any more time!
say:24:1120305017:1.source_cn: 好。这孩子的病情应该也不能再耽误了。

say:27:1120305018:0.text: *Cough* A-Alsa... Where are you all going...?
say:27:1120305018:0.source_cn: 咳、咳咳……呜……阿尔萨姐姐，你们要去哪里……

say:28:1120305019:0.text: We're going out to find you even better medicine. Once we bring it back, you'll feel better in no time.
say:28:1120305019:0.source_cn: 乖孩子，我们要去帮你找药。吃下那种药，你就会好起来的。

say:29:1120305020:0.text: That's why, no matter how uncomfortable it gets, you have to hang on until we get back. Understand?
say:29:1120305020:0.source_cn: 所以在我们回来之前，不管多难受你都要坚持住，好吗？

say:30:1120305021:1.text: I'll make sure the others take good care of you until we return.
say:30:1120305021:1.source_cn: 我会拜托其他人好好照顾你的。

say:31:1120305022:0.text: O-Okay! *Cough* I'll do exactly what you say, Alsa. Come back soon, okay?
say:31:1120305022:0.source_cn: 好！咳，咳……我相信阿尔萨姐姐！我会乖乖等你们回来的！

say:32:1120305023:1.text: ...He won't last much longer in his condition.
say:32:1120305023:1.source_cn: ……这孩子的情况，应该不能再拖了。

say:33:1120305024:1.text: I know, which is why we need to go to the arena and find Mikola right away!
say:33:1120305024:1.source_cn: 嗯。事不宜迟，我们赶紧去武斗场找曼卡拉吧！

say:35:1120305014:1.text: We don't have the luxury of time right now. Let's just ask Smokey and see where that leads.
say:35:1120305014:1.source_cn: 我们现在时间紧张，可以先试试阿熏这条线索。

choice:20:1:2.text: We should think of something else.
choice:20:1:2.male: We should think of something else.
choice:20:1:2.female: We should think of something else.

choice:11:1:2.text: Let's find another way to treat him.
choice:11:1:2.male: Let's find another way to treat him.
choice:11:1:2.female: Let's find another way to treat him.
